description: Header file defining the DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher class responsible for fetching PAC files via DHCP on Windows, including its internal state machine, methods, and related classes.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Main class managing DHCP lookup and PAC file fetching for a network adapter, including state management, callback handling, and internal DHCP query class.

classes.name: DhcpQuery
classes.description: Inner class encapsulating DHCP query work on a worker thread, retrieving the PAC URL from DHCP.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Starts the process of DHCP lookup and PAC file fetch for a specified network adapter.

methods.name: DidFinish
methods.description: Checks if the fetch process has completed successfully.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Returns the network error code indicating fetch result.

methods.name: GetPacScript
methods.description: Returns the fetched PAC script content if available.

methods.name: GetPacURL
methods.description: Returns the PAC URL retrieved from DHCP.

methods.name: GetPacURLFromDhcp
methods.description: Static method to synchronously get PAC URL from DHCP for a given adapter.

methods.name: SanitizeDhcpApiString
methods.description: Sanitizes a string returned via DHCP API.
